title: Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine
description:
Overview

Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine at Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc. (CHC). Reports To: Chief Medical Officer. FLSA Status: Exempt. Wage Range: $9,230.77 - $11,220.06 bi-weekly.

Summary: Under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, but with independent responsibility for professional results, the Physician provides primary healthcare services for CHC and performs related work as required. CHC aims to provide the highest quality of total care to the patient population; employees are expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Secure and evaluate a patient''s health history and record findings in a systematic, accurate, and succinct manner.
  • Perform physical assessments and discriminate between normal and abnormal findings.
  • Provide routine physical examinations, diagnostic services, and treatment of illnesses and emergencies.
  • Adhere to high ethical standards and assure quality of care for all patients.
  • Share on-call duties with other medical staff as indicated.
  • Elicit and record information about patient medical history; examine patients to determine general physical condition.
  • Order or execute tests, analyses, and diagnostic images; analyze reports and findings to diagnose conditions.
  • Administer or prescribe treatments and drugs; inoculate and vaccinate patients; advise on diet, hygiene, and disease prevention.
  • Report births, deaths, and outbreaks to governmental authorities; refer patients to specialists when needed.
  • Perform minor surgeries and conduct physicals for school admissions, job considerations, or insurance eligibility.
  • Assist the Chief Medical Officer in establishing medical policies and education programs; participate in care coordination and policy development as required.
  • Share supervisory responsibilities of the nurse practitioner with the Clinical Director as required; work within privileges and protocols established by the CMO.
  • Participate in committees as requested; adhere to safety and infection control policies; provide age-appropriate care across patient populations.
  • Maintain HIPAA-compliant, confidential communications; participate in patient population management with cultural sensitivity and appropriate local resources.
  • Coordinate with the Care Team to arrange appropriate services and support patient goals; contribute to quality improvement using evidence-based practices.

Supervisory Responsibilities

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

Qualifications

  • Education: Medical Doctor (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school.
  • Residency: Completion in Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN, or Pediatrics; board certified or board eligible.
  • Licenses and Certifications: Current, unrestricted Physician and Surgeon license in California; current DEA license; ACLS for FP/IM; PALS for Pediatrics; BLS (all specialties).
  • Continuing education: Maintains current knowledge through CME and participation in relevant medical societies.
  • Language Skills: English required; Spanish bilingual desirable.

Education And/or Experience

As listed under Qualifications above.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to perform essential duties and accommodate reasonable accommodations as needed.
  • Physical demands and work environment as described below may apply: willing to work flexible hours, occasional travel to other clinic sites.

Note: This job description contains general information and is not an exhaustive listing of duties and responsibilities. EEO statements and other legally required notices remain in effect.

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.
As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.
While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.
The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.
This role reports to the CISO.
What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
What we are looking for
  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness
Optional things we value
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

title: GERENTE DE COMPLIANCE
description:
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Garantir a conformidade legal e regulatória da organização por meio do desenvolvimento e implementação de programas eficazes de compliance, com foco em Anticorrupção, Direito da Concorrência e Controles de Comércio Exterior. Atuar na aplicação e monitoramento das normativas em todas as áreas do negócio, fornecendo orientação estratégica para mitigar riscos e assegurar boas práticas corporativas. Manter relacionamento ativo com autoridades brasileiras e órgãos reguladores, assegurando a transparência e integridade das operações. Promover a cultura ética dentro da organização por meio de treinamentos, auditorias e políticas de conformidade.

Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Direito, Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Compliance, Governança ou Direito Público.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Compliance: Atuar na criação e execução de medidas para um programa de conformidade eficaz, focado em Anticorrupção, Direito da Concorrência e Controles de Comércio Exterior. Garantir a aderência dos processos internos às regulamentações vigentes.
  • Consultoria Interna: Auxiliar as áreas do negócio a respeito dos normativos internos, fornecendo orientação sobre questões de compliance. Propor soluções para as demandas de modo a mitigar eventuais riscos.
  • Monitoramento e Revisão de Controles Internos: Avaliar continuamente os controles internos, monitorando a aderência das operações às normativas aplicáveis. Propor melhorias e ajustes para fortalecer a governança e minimizar riscos regulatórios.
  • Elaboração e Revisão de Políticas de Integridade: Auxiliar na revisão periódica, bem como na elaboração de políticas e procedimentos do Programa de Integridade da empresa, de modo a garantir que todos os documentos estejam em conformidade com as legislações aplicáveis e necessidades da empresa.
  • Avaliação de Riscos e Due Diligence: Auxiliar na condução de avaliações de risco corporativo conforme a Lei nº 12.846/2013, garantindo a validação da gerência da área. Executar due diligence em parceiros, fornecedores e terceiros para mitigar riscos de compliance.
  • Suporte em Auditorias Internas e Externas: Atuar como referência técnica nas auditorias, preparando documentações e assegurando o cumprimento dos requisitos normativos. Apoiar a implementação de melhorias em resposta a eventuais não-conformidades.
  • Treinamento e Capacitação em Compliance: Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos para colaboradores sobre normas, regulamentos e diretrizes do Programa de Integridade. Criar estratégias educacionais para promover a cultura ética na organização.
  • Monitoramento da Conformidade com Regulamentos de Controle de Comércio Exterior: Acompanhar a aplicação dos requisitos regulatórios de controle de comércio exterior, de modo a assegurar que as operações estejam alinhadas às legislações nacionais e internacionais aplicáveis.
  • Relatórios e Indicadores de Compliance: Elaborar relatórios anuais e periódicos com métricas do Programa de Integridade para a Alta Administração (Conselho e Diretoria) e eventuais outros stakeholders. Manter indicadores de performance dos pilares da área para garantir a melhoria contínua.

title: Enterprise Sales Manager
description:
Enterprise Sales Manager

Job Purpose

The Enterprise Sales Manager is responsible for driving new revenue growth through proactive outreach, prospecting, and pipeline development, while also expanding existing enterprise customer relationships. Leads will be generated through multiple channels, including marketing campaigns, third‑party lead generation, and self‑sourced outreach.

An Enterprise customer is defined as any organisation with 200+ white‑collar employees, and the role will span both national and international client requirements, depending on account footprint and opportunity scope.

This role plays a critical part in positioning IWG’s full suite of solutions to large organisations across multiple markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate profitable new revenue by identifying, prospecting, and converting new Enterprise clients.
  • Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified sales opportunities across multiple sectors and geographies.
  • Conduct strategic outreach through direct engagement, events, and third‑party referrals to identify high‑potential prospects.
  • Own the full sales cycle — from first contact to close — with an emphasis on front‑end activity and deal progression.
  • Create and execute Account Plans to grow wallet share within assigned strategic accounts.
  • Build and maintain executive‑level relationships to gain insight into client needs and translate insights into tailored workspace solutions.
  • Collaborate with brokers, real estate advisors, and consultants to generate opportunities and increase IWG’s market visibility.
  • Partner cross‑functionally with regional Sales, Operations, and Product teams to ensure seamless solution delivery.
  • Continuously gather and share feedback from prospects and clients to improve product‑market fit and go‑to‑market effectiveness.
  • Deliver accurate pipeline forecasts, activity reports, and performance updates.

Required Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven track record in B2B prospecting, business development, and solution selling.
  • Ability to independently source and qualify leads in complex, consultative sales environments.
  • Strong understanding of the enterprise customer buying journey and long‑cycle deal management.
  • Experience working with and influencing C‑level stakeholders.
  • Background in commercial real estate, enterprise services, or flexible workspace is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets through self‑generated pipeline.
  • Strong negotiation and contract structuring skills.
  • High level of commercial acumen and results orientation.
  • Comfortable working in global, matrixed organisations with distributed teams.
  • Adaptable, proactive, and confident navigating ambiguity.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.
  • Native Portuguese and fluent/conversational English

About the company

IWG has been at the forefront of flexible working for more than 30 years. With over 3,500 locations around the globe, spanning brands including Regus, Spaces, Signature and HQ, we have made it possible for businesses of all sizes to make the transition to hybrid working, empowering employees to work wherever and whenever is most convenient.

We help more than 8 million people and their businesses to work more productively, supported by a choice of professional, inspiring and collaborative workspaces, communities and services.

As the world’s leading provider of hybrid work solutions, with four times the number of locations compared to its nearest competitor, IWG is already working with over 80% of the Fortune 500 and counts businesses including Amazon, Netflix, EY and Uber amongst its customers.

Companies of all sizes are shifting to flexible working to lower costs, improve employee retention and lower their carbon emissions. The flexible workspace is expected to grow by 600% by 2023, when 30% of all office space will be hybrid. We are growing our network faster than ever to keep up with demand from customers as we work towards our goal of reaching 30,000 centres.

Carbon Neutral Workplaces

IWG’s purpose of helping everyone have a great day at work, while protecting people and the planet is at the heart of everything we do. We are proud to supply all of our customers worldwide with carbon neutral workplaces, and we have a strong climate action plan in place to help us achieve our objective of Net Zero emissions by 2040.

Leading Employer Award IWG is proud to be the recipient of a Leading Employer Award in 2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025. Awarded exclusively to the top 1% of employers, the accolade is testament to our diverse global workforce and the role everyone plays in bringing our purpose, culture and values to life, every single day.

About Eliis

Founded in 2007, Eliis is a company of over 90 professionals with a strong international presence. We are recognized as a leading player in the geoscience software industry, delivering innovative and high-performance solutions—through our flagship seismic interpretation platform, PaleoScan™—to support major energy companies in addressing complex subsurface challenges.

Driven by our expertise and commitment to innovation, we aim to provide our clients with advanced tools that enable informed decision-making and push the boundaries of subsurface interpretation. As part of our ongoing efforts to support the energy transition, we are also developing dedicated assessment solutions for the underground storage of CO₂.

About the Role

This is a full-time hybrid position for a Regional Sales Manager based in Rio de Janeiro, RJ. The role includes both remote work and regular in-office presence as needed.

As Regional Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving commercial growth and managing client relationships across the LATAM South Cone region. A key part of this role is leading the regional Sales, Support, and Technical teams, ensuring alignment, motivation, and performance across functions. You will play a critical role in setting priorities, guiding execution, and fostering collaboration between departments.

This is both a strategic and hands‑on position that requires strong leadership, an understanding of the energy and geoscience space, and a genuine commitment to client success.

  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and meetings.

What You Bring

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience in Sales, Business Development, and Client Relationship Management.
  • Previous experience leading teams or cross‑functional groups.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Proactive and innovative attitude with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Solid knowledge of Seismic Interpretation, Geosciences, and the Energy sector.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and PipeDrive (or similar CRM tools).
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Geosciences, Petroleum Engineering, Business, IT, or a related field.

Nice to Have

  • Demonstrated leadership and team management skills — experience supervising cross‑functional or commercial teams.
  • Prior experience in the oil & gas or energy tech sector is a strong advantage.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on Cutting‑Edge Technology in seismic interpretation & subsurface analysis.
  • Be Part of a Global Team with colleagues across Europe, the Americas and beyond.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

As an Editor at Darkroom, your primary duty will be to develop and assist in the development of marketing collateral, including video content and organic content. Our Editors add immense value to our client's work through native content and strategies. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about using their editing skills to tell a compelling story and help our customers grow their businesses.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

Who You Are:

  • Experience creating platform native content (including video content and organic content), especially IG Reels, Meta ads, and TikTok viral video campaigns

  • Exceptional time management and organization skills with the ability to manage deliverables across an array of brands

  • Strong Motion Graphics/ Graphic Design/ Typography skills required

  • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro + FCPX

  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (especially Media Encoder, After Effects, Premiere, and Photoshop)

  • Familiarity with broadcast finishing workflows (mix, color, VFX, conform, online)

  • Familiarity working in a networked server environment

  • Strong technical knowledge of codecs and transcoding practices

  • Strong time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communication skills

  • Proficient with animation/ graphic design preferred

What You'll Do:

  • You will be editing UGC-style videos in a variety of content formats

  • Develop and execute thumb-stopping social media video edits, layer audio seamlessly and overlay text that drives key brand messaging

  • Brainstorm inventive edits and hooks that drive engagement, leverage new formats

  • Stay current on all social media platforms, ad offerings, content publishers, tools, trends, and best practices

  • Be a creative collaborator: Have the ability to be the voice of the brand and the influencer to create content that is authentic and powerful for all channels

  • Be comfortable using video editing software, editing audio, and taking editing direction, while working in a fast pace environment

  • Provide accessible content that includes closed captioning, voiceover, and overlay text in a variety of aspect ratios

  • Setting up projects for edit staff

  • Ingesting and logging footage

  • Working in tandem with edit staff to meet deadlines

  • Editing lower-level projects

  • Maintaining media storage (hard drives, servers, GDrive)

  • Mastering deliverables and archiving projects

  • Assisting senior staff with edit and administrative needs

  • Versioning various aspect ratios of completed edits

  • Maintaining all software and assets (Mac OSX, server operating system, frame.io, Vimeo, shared assets)

  • Coordinating and troubleshooting edit equipment

  • Reporting to the Post-Production Supervisor and Producers, the AE will upon request create high-quality video edits that will span various media platforms

  • Performance creative editing (collaborating with the performance marketing team in reviewing ad analytics/performance)

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

title: ANALISTA SISTEMAS - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04 / 03 / 1966, 40.103 de 17 / 05 / 1962 e 8.911, de 30 / 07 / 1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Betting Content Support Specialist . You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze bugs, maintain high-quality betting content, analyze trends and metrics to support data-driven decision-making, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our app.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and ensure the accuracy of betting-related content and features within the app.
  • Identify, report, and document bugs or issues related to betting functionality.
  • Analyze betting-related issues to understand root causes and propose actionable solutions.
  • Use analytical tools (primarily Google Sheets/Excel) to calculate metrics, validate data accuracy, and measure content or feature performance.
  • Apply logical and quantitative analysis to identify patterns, errors, and optimization opportunities.
  • Coordinate the planning, execution, and completion of tasks and projects related to betting within the scores app.

  • Stay up-to-date on industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies related to sports betting.

Requirements

  • Strong passion for sports and familiarity with betting platforms and terminology.
  • Strong familiarity with the sports betting world is required – including understanding odds, expected value, and key sports trends. Personal or professional experience in betting is a significant advantage.
  • Excellent logical and analytical skills for troubleshooting and resolving issues effectively.
  • High proficiency with Google Sheets or Excel, including formulas, lookups, conditional logic, and pivot tables.
  • Ability to calculate and interpret key performance indicators (KPIs) and basic ROI or accuracy metrics.
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to spot errors or inconsistencies in betting data.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, ensuring the accuracy of betting-related content.
  • Proficient verbal and written communication skills in English to clearly report findings and collaborate effectively.
  • Creative problem solver with a proactive approach to finding solutions.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

As a plus

  • Experience in technical support, QA, or similar roles in the sports or betting industry is a plus.
  • Familiarity with tools and methodologies for issue tracking and bug reporting (e.g., Jira).
  • Basic understanding of data flows in apps or backend systems is an advantage.
  • Experience working in a data-focused role within the international betting industry.

  • Experience building reports, automations, or analytical dashboards using spreadsheets or similar tools.

title: Compliance Analyst
description:
About Crown

We exist to make money work better. That means eliminating the friction of integrating the Brazilian Real into the blockchain economy without sacrificing trust, safety, or compliance.

With the conviction that programmable money is the future of finance, we built BRLV . Anchored by a 1:1 backing of sovereign Brazilian treasury assets, BRLV is the safe, scalable settlement layer designed for the tokenized economy.

We’re backed by Framework, Valor, Norte, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, and Nubank co‑founder Ed Wible. Our goal: R$1 trillion of BRLV in circulation within 10 years.

The Role

As a Compliance Analyst at Crown, you will be a cornerstone of our risk management framework, operating across both the first and second lines of defense. You will serve as the primary compliance liaison for our institutional clients and partners, guiding them through our rigorous due diligence process while performing critical risk analysis to protect the firm. This role requires a unique blend of client‑facing communication skills and deep analytical rigor. You will work directly with the Chief Compliance Officer and the broader risk function to implement and uphold our institutional‑grade AML/CFT Policy.

  • Institutional Onboarding (1st Line): Act as the main point of contact for institutional clients during the entire onboarding lifecycle. You will guide them through the appropriate Due Diligence Questionnaire (for Brazilian, U.S., or other non‑U.S. entities), ensuring all mandatory documentation—such as constitutional documents, AML/CFT policies, and ownership charts—is collected completely and accurately.
  • Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Risk Assessment (2nd Line): Conduct comprehensive reviews of prospective clients, applying our risk‑based approach. This includes analyzing complex corporate structures to identify and verify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) according to our dynamic thresholds.
  • Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Execute enhanced due diligence for high‑risk clients, including Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), VASPs, and other financial institutions. This involves a critical assessment of the client’s own AML program, their independent audit reports, and the source of their funds and wealth.
  • Transaction Monitoring Support (2nd Line): Assist in the analysis of alerts generated by our on‑chain and fiat transaction monitoring systems. You will investigate atypical activity, adhering to strict internal SLAs for resolution (e.g., 24 hours for critical alerts), and prepare dossiers for potential Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to be submitted to COAF.
  • Record Keeping and Data Protection: Ensure all due diligence, risk assessments, and client communications are meticulously documented and securely stored, in compliance with our policies and regulatory requirements. You will handle highly sensitive client data and must adhere strictly to our Information Security Policy and data protection principles (LGPD).

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a compliance, KYC/AML, risk, or client onboarding role within a VASP, fintech, or regulated financial institution.
  • You have a deep and practical understanding of Brazilian AML/CFT regulations (e.g., Law 14.478/22, COAF reporting) and are familiar with international FATF standards.
  • You are fluent in both Portuguese and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills required to interact with sophisticated institutional clients and internal stakeholders.
  • You have a highly analytical mindset and an obsessive attention to detail, capable of dissecting complex legal and corporate structures to identify underlying risks.
  • You thrive in ownership-driven environments. You’re highly accountable for your work and don’t require others following up on it.
  • You naturally operate cross-functionally, with strong collaborative instincts toward legal, operations, and technology teams.
  • You are energized by the challenge of building and refining compliance processes from the ground up in a fast-paced environment.

What’s Different About Working Here

  • Small by design. We don’t hire layers of managers. Everyone builds.
  • Ownership is total. You own the function end‑to‑end—and ask for input when it makes the work better, not because someone’s checking.
  • Ruthlessly simple. We don’t paper over complexity with process or headcount.
  • Collaboration is default. Problems are shared property. We work across domains.
  • Feedback is candid and direct. Built on the assumption that everyone here is smart, competent, and cares.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary
  • Full health coverage
  • VA

Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Atribuições e responsabilidades:

    • Desenvolver protótipos de novos produtos, considerando o design, materiais, funcionalidades e estética.

    • Definir os processos produtivos necessários para fabricar os produtos conforme os requisitos de qualidade e prazos estabelecidos.
    • Ajustar padrões de produção, como cortes, modelagem e costura, para garantir que o produto final atenda às especificações.
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção, identificar possíveis problemas técnicos e sugerir soluções para otimizar o processo.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Realizar inspeções durante e após a produção para verificar se os produtos atendem aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
    • Coordenar ou realizar testes de durabilidade, resistência, lavagem e outros parâmetros técnicos para assegurar a conformidade do produto final.
    • Identificar e tratar desvios de qualidade, propondo melhorias ou ajustes nos processos produtivos ou de design.
  4. Ajustes e Melhorias Contínuas
    • Coletar feedback de clientes, áreas de vendas e outras partes envolvidas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos.
    • Propor melhorias no processo de produção visando reduzir custos, melhorar a eficiência e garantir a qualidade.
    • Acompanhar inovações tecnológicas no setor têxtil e sugerir a implementação de novas técnicas ou equipamentos que melhorem o produto ou o processo produtivo.
  5. Gestão de Documentação Técnica
    • Atualizar constantemente as fichas técnicas, garantindo que as informações estejam corretas e acessíveis para as equipes de produção e comercialização.
    • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre o andamento do desenvolvimento de produtos, incluindo testes, qualidade e melhorias implementadas.
  6. Interação com Outras Áreas
    • Colaborar estreitamente com equipes de design e estilistas para garantir que as ideias criativas sejam viáveis do ponto de vista técnico e de produção.
    • Fornecer suporte técnico para a equipe comercial, ajudando a explicar os diferenciais e especificações dos produtos aos clientes ou consumidores.
    • Treinar os operadores de produção, modelistas e outros profissionais envolvidos na fabricação sobre os processos e padrões exigidos.
  7. Sustentabilidade e Conformidade
    • Trabalhar para implementar práticas de produção mais sustentáveis, selecionando materiais ecológicos e otimizando processos para reduzir desperdícios.
    • Garantir que os produtos atendam às normas de segurança, regulamentos ambientais e padrões internacionais de qualidade.

Como uma pessoa Gerente da área de Consultoria Contábil Financeira (FAAS) você apoiará na determinação, no monitoramento e divulgação de informações financeiras e não financeiras para os stakeholders. Advert 2H Offshore is a global engineering contractor specializing in the design, engineering and integrity management of offshore structures, topsides facilities, subsea components and riser and conductor systems for the offshore oil and gas and renewables sectors. Position Description

We are seeking a Field Compliance Coordinator to join our Upstream OE & Compliance Division. The Division is responsible for providing safety support to Upstream Executive Management and various organizations through HSE reporting, safety audits, recommendations, human‑factor guidance, training, major incident investigations, and lessons‑learned creation. Your primary role will support upstream organizations on Process Safety and major incident investigations for onshore and offshore drilling and oil & gas processing plants.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enhance safety standards and procedures such as work permits, process safety, hazard identification, risk management, and emergency preparedness.
  • Develop loss‑prevention, fire‑prevention, and safety standards, procedures, and General Instructions (GIs) for matters not covered by existing resources.
  • Consult with upstream management to facilitate Safety Management System (SMS) enhancement.
  • Create critical safety documents for major activities such as job safety analyses and hazard identification plans.
  • Assist departments in preparing for major safety reviews, including loss‑prevention compliance reviews.
  • Research emerging safety technologies and conduct feasibility studies and cost analyses to identify improved solutions for existing safety problems and regulatory requirements.
  • Act as a process‑safety audit expert during design, construction, commissioning, turnover to operations, ongoing operations, change management, and decommissioning.
  • Develop and deliver safety training material and safe‑work procedures to field personnel.
  • Instruct on safety concepts, practices, and standards (both on‑the‑job and classroom).
  • Direct and participate in preparing major reference manuals documenting corporate and LP safety systems, policies, and procedures (e.g., LP Policy, SMS manual, Safety Handbook, Construction Safety Manual).
  • Facilitate and lead incident investigations, including interviewing witnesses, gathering data, and conducting root‑cause analysis.
  • Facilitate and lead safety audits by identifying non‑compliance with occupational health and safety regulations and advising on improvements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, HSE, or an equivalent accredited program.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in upstream organizations spanning exploration, drilling, and production on both onshore and offshore sites, with at least 5 years in a senior loss‑prevention or fire‑prevention role.
  • Strong technical expertise in process safety disciplines such as design engineering, loss control management, hazard identification, HAZOP reviews, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, response, and safety management systems.
  • Experience with HAZOP and SIL studies is preferred; internationally recognized certifications are advantageous.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by challenging and rewarding professional, technical, and industrial opportunities, and are remunerated accordingly.

Benefits

Permanent expatriate relocation package, competitive compensation, and opportunities for career development within a global energy leader.

    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).

    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP :

    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).

  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).

  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping , tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.

  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS .
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6 .
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA , etc.).

  • Conhece TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana) .
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG .
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

title: ENGENHEIRO TÉCNICO DE PRODUTO FOCO EM BIQUINI
description:
Estamos com uma posição para Engenheiro técnico de produto com foco em biquíni. Suas atividades estarão voltadas para o desenvolvimento, melhoria e controle de qualidade de produtos têxteis, atuando em diversas etapas do processo de criação e fabricação, garantindo que os produtos atendam aos requisitos técnicos e de mercado.

Atribuições e responsabilidades:

  1. Análise e Desenvolvimento de Produto
    • Desenvolver protótipos de novos produtos, considerando o design, materiais, funcionalidades e estética.
    • Elaborar fichas técnicas detalhadas com todas as especificações do produto (materiais, cores, tamanhos, acabamentos, técnicas de costura, etc.).
    • Avaliar e selecionar materiais adequados para cada tipo de produto, garantindo qualidade e adequação à funcionalidade do design.
  2. Processo de Produção
    • Definir os processos produtivos necessários para fabricar os produtos conforme os requisitos de qualidade e prazos estabelecidos.
    • Ajustar padrões de produção, como cortes, modelagem e costura, para garantir que o produto final atenda às especificações.
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção, identificar possíveis problemas técnicos e sugerir soluções para otimizar o processo.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Realizar inspeções durante e após a produção para verificar se os produtos atendem aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
    • Coordenar ou realizar testes de durabilidade, resistência, lavagem e outros parâmetros técnicos para assegurar a conformidade do produto final.
    • Identificar e tratar desvios de qualidade, propondo melhorias ou ajustes nos processos produtivos ou de design.
  4. Ajustes e Melhorias Contínuas
    • Coletar feedback de clientes, áreas de vendas e outras partes envolvidas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos.
    • Propor melhorias no processo de produção visando reduzir custos, melhorar a eficiência e garantir a qualidade.
    • Acompanhar inovações tecnológicas no setor têxtil e sugerir a implementação de novas técnicas ou equipamentos que melhorem o produto ou o processo produtivo.
  5. Gestão de Documentação Técnica
    • Atualizar constantemente as fichas técnicas, garantindo que as informações estejam corretas e acessíveis para as equipes de produção e comercialização.
    • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre o andamento do desenvolvimento de produtos, incluindo testes, qualidade e melhorias implementadas.
  6. Interação com Outras Áreas
    • Colaborar estreitamente com equipes de design e estilistas para garantir que as ideias criativas sejam viáveis do ponto de vista técnico e de produção.
    • Fornecer suporte técnico para a equipe comercial, ajudando a explicar os diferenciais e especificações dos produtos aos clientes ou consumidores.
    • Treinar os operadores de produção, modelistas e outros profissionais envolvidos na fabricação sobre os processos e padrões exigidos.
  7. Sustentabilidade e Conformidade
    • Trabalhar para implementar práticas de produção mais sustentáveis, selecionando materiais ecológicos e otimizando processos para reduzir desperdícios.
    • Garantir que os produtos atendam às normas de segurança, regulamentos ambientais e padrões internacionais de qualidade.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia têxtil;

Experiência em varejo de moda, com foco em biquíni.

Local de trabalho: São Cristóvão - RJ, 100% presencial.

title: Completion Engineer (Lower Completion Specialist)
description:
Focusing on lower completions, this position will plan, design, and execute lower completion and gravel pack operations, provide offshore technical supervision, coordinate with wells, subsurface, and operations teams, and ensure proper well closeout and reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by Subsurface team
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly Budgets and well/project specific AFE's
  • Forecast and accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific Long Lead requirements
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination & quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required including conducting service quality meetings
  • Ensure Vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the Company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process so as to ensure timely action/close out
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required
  • Contributor to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS)
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, and execution and closeout activities
  • Ensure compliance with Company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures
  • Ensure compliance of Vendor supplied materials, equipment and services which includes review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and 3rd party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations

Well/Project Specific Duties

  • Design Reservoir Lower Completion for producer and injector wells across different assets within the company
  • Perform Torque & Drag analysis for deploying lower completions in long horizontal wells. Specify landing string and evaluate the requirement for swiveling devices
  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team which includes lower completion sizing and design, GP pumping schedule, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities
  • Establish well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material & equipment selection
  • Identify special Engineering Studies to be performed
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and capable of presenting a succinct recommendation
  • Raise Requisitions & Purchase Orders
  • Ensure compliance of Vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services which includes but is not limited to review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation

description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to

Awards and Acknowledgements

Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. The company has been included on the Forbes World’s Best Cloud Companies, Fast Company\u2019s Most Innovative list, and Inc.’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies. We’ve also been recognized as a 2023 Built In Best Place to Work in the U.S., a Muse VIBE Award winner in the Vacation and Time Off category and certified as a Great Place to Work.

title: PESSOA TÉCNICO DE IMOBILIZAÇÃO ORTOPÉDICA - HOSPITAL CASA SANTA CRZ  - CLT/RJ - VAGA INCLUSIVA PCD
description:
Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada;
  • Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento;
  • Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica;
  • Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações;
  • Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações;
  • Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória;
  • Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado;
  • Manter sala de imobilização organizada;
  • Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade;
  • Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual;
  • Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados;
  • Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes;
  • Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento;
  • Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente;
  • Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação;

Join to apply for the Card Authority and Disputes Administrator role at Paymentology .

At Paymentology , we’re redefining what’s possible in the payments space. It's this global reach and innovation that sets us apart.

We’re looking for a Card Authority and Disputes Administrator to manage and process chargebacks, transaction disputes, and card authority operations across global card networks. This role ensures every case and authorisation exception is validated, documented, and resolved in line with regulatory and card scheme standards. You’ll play a key role in protecting clients and cardholders from financial loss while upholding Paymentology’s operational integrity, operating independently on assigned cases and prioritising workload against SLA and regulatory deadlines.

  • Handle and process cardholder disputes involving authorised and unauthorised transactions.

  • Oversee card authority processes including transaction approvals, declines, and authorisation reviews.
  • Provide guidance to internal teams and clients on dispute outcomes, escalations, and card authorisation queries.
  • Maintain current knowledge of card scheme rules, dispute categories, and operational procedures.

Requirements

  • Strong understanding of Visa/Mastercard dispute and card authorisation processes and compliance standards.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Analytical, customer‑centric, and detail‑oriented, with the ability to work to tight deadlines.
  • Able to coordinate with card network partners, client operations teams, and internal reconciliation staff to ensure compliance and customer satisfaction.
  • 2–4 years in dispute resolution, card operations, or financial customer service.

At Paymentology , it’s not just about building great payment technology, it’s about building a company where people feel they belong and their work matters. You’ll be part of a diverse, global team that’s genuinely committed to making a positive impact through what we do. The Position

The Senior Telecom Manager is responsible for managing the Telecom Infrastructure planning, delivery, and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties on the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Telecom services pertinent to the tournament and/or associated events within Brazil.

  • Review Telecom Infrastructure design and ensure all aspects of the Telecom deliverables are implemented at venues and offices according to FIFA requirements: Broadcast Contribution Network, Event/Stadium/Offices/Legacy Networks, CATV/IPTV, Cabling, Mobile Network, Radio and Spectrum, Telephony (VoIP), Telecom Rate Card.

  • Deliver technical guidance, coaching & mentoring to team members, including preparation of good practice and educational material for personnel.

  • University degree or similar higher education in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum experience of 8-10 years in Network (routing/switching/security/wireless technologies)

  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex Telecom Infrastructure Projects
  • Experience in Management of distributed international team of telecom experts and professionals

  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team player, willing to work with tight timelines

  • Elaboração de análise preliminar de riscos, conforme padrões e normas;
  • Avaliação de sondas quanto otimização a segurança operacional contemplando, mas não limitado aos seguintes itens (Capacidade de corte do BOP, disponibilidade de EDS’s, avaliação do sistema de compensação e de posicionamento dinâmico da unidade e dos obstáculos na locação);
  • Elaboração de gestões de mudança de projeto;
  • Suportar a elaboração do documento de passagem de serviço dos poços (Handover);
  • Suportar a elaboração das análises de envelope operacional e conjunto solidários de barreiras.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Curso de Nível Superior em Engenharia em instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC) ou outro órgão do governo federal destinado a esse fim, com registro no respectivo Conselho de Classe.
  • Experiência: Em projeto e/ou execução de perfuração de poços de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Competência de Dados — tratamento, transferência, coleta, organização, agrupamento, noções de análise estatística, árvore de decisão; Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point; Power BI: Noções, filtros, organização dos dados, pesquisa. Operação básica com dados; Noções de projeto de poço marítimo; Noções de construção de poço direcional, vertical e horizontal como operador e como projetista: premissas básicas de projetos, limitações e boas práticas em projetos e execução; Noções de equipamentos de sondas de perfuração; Noções de conceitos básicos de perfuração direcional; Conhecimento de ferramentas direcionais: motores de fundo, rotary steerable e turbinas de perfuração (seleção, limites operacionais, vantagens e desvantagens e operação); Noções de ferramentas de mapeamento de poço: MWD, GWD, Gyro; Noções de ferramentas de perfilagem: LWD e ferramentas a cabo. Limites e operação (poço aberto e poço revestido); Influência do direcional nas descidas a cabo por gravidade; Noções de projeto de BHA: tubulares, alargadores, escareadores, percussores de perfuração; Noções de operação e projeto utilizando sistemas de alargamento (alargadores, ferramentas de eliminação de offset broca x alargador em manobra única, estabilização no poço alargado etc.); Noções de simulação: torque e drag, hidráulica de poço e desgaste de revestimento; Noções de brocas de perfuração: seleção e cálculo de hidráulica; Noções de hidráulica de poço: correlação entre limpeza de poço e geometria de trajetória; Noções de segurança de poço e análise anticolisão entre poços; Noções de geologia e geodésia; Noções de orçamentação de poços; Noções de operação e projeto de testemunhagem; Noções de operações e projeto de canhoneio; Noções de operações e projeto de MPD; Noções básicas dos tipos de completação (contenção de areia, completações simples e inteligentes, etc.); Noções básicas sobre cimentação, recimentação e correção da cimentação; Aplicação do canhoneio nos diferentes tipos de completação (cargas e densidades); Noções básicas de workover e de abandono; Noções básicas de caracterização de reservatório (geologia, geofísica e avaliação de reservatórios); Idiomas: Português (Brasil) - escrita e oral – nível fluente; Inglês técnico - escrita e oral - nível intermediário; Possuir noções básicas de construção de poços marítimos e dos equipamentos e sistemas de unidades de perfuração marítima; Desejáveis noções básicas em brocas, perfuração direcional, MPD, integridade de poços, estabilidade geomecânica de poços, fundações de poços, fluidos de perfuração, cimentação e equipamentos que compõem a estrutura de poços (cabeça de poço, revestimentos etc).

Esta oportunidade de trabalho está aberta a qualquer pessoa independente de religião, cor, deficiência física ou mental não incapacitante para o trabalho, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero. O CIEDS é contrário a qualquer forma de discriminação e está comprometido com a inclusão, a diversidade e a igualdade de oportunidades. Se você acha que pode se beneficiar da nossa política de ação afirmativa, por favor informe na sua candidatura.

Missão:
Atuar como ponte entre empreendedores, autônomos e organizações dos territórios atendidos, oferecendo suporte acessível e personalizado para fortalecer a atividade econômica local. Através de um atendimento próximo e humanizado, conectar essas iniciativas a ferramentas, redes de apoio e oportunidades que impulsionem seu desenvolvimento sustentável.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Esclarecer que o atendimento é um suporte gratuito para incentivar a atividade econômica na favela.
  • Organizar e executar atendimentos presenciais ou agendados.
  • Lançamento dos atendimentos no sistema de coleta de dados.
  • Envio do questionário via WhatsApp para avaliação do atendimento.
  • Direcionamento para canais de apoio ou outros serviços quando aplicável.
  • Inserção dos atendidos na rede de empreendimentos do CIEDS.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ser maior de 21 anos.
  • Estar em formação, preferencialmente em cursos técnicos, superiores ou de pós-graduação, nos cursos de Administração, Gestão de Negócios, Engenharia de Produção, Economia ou áreas afins.
  • Residir nos territórios de abrangência do projeto: Campo Grande, Complexo da Penha e Nova Iguaçu.
  • Ter boa comunicação e habilidades interpessoais, pautadas no respeito, honestidade e cordialidade.
  • Ser proativo e capaz de realizar busca ativa de empreendedores de forma autônoma.
  • Ter interesse por empreendedorismo, inclusão produtiva e cultura das favelas.

Tempo de Experiência:

  • Não há tempo mínimo de experiência exigido, mas experiências prévias na área são um diferencial.

Conhecimentos Específicos:

  • Capacidade de mobilização e articulação em comunidades.
  • Habilidade para comunicação eficaz e criação de redes de relacionamento.
  • Conhecimento sobre o ecossistema de empreendedorismo e inclusão produtiva.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia como empreendedor ou já ter enfrentado o fechamento de um negócio.
  • Experiência com vendas.
  • Experiência com orientação de negócios.
  • Participação em projetos de formação de lideranças e mobilização social.

Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast‑growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on‑boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on‑boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on‑boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post‑sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on‑boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on‑boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem‑solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world‑class on‑boarding experience.

  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information

  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software
